questions.prompt: You drag a Button from the Toolbox onto `Form1` in the Visual Studio Designer. Where does the code that creates that button end up?
options: Nowhere; the Designer stores controls only in the project file
questions.explanation: Controls dragged from the Toolbox have their code automatically generated in `InitializeComponent()`. You can also set their properties in the Properties window or in code.

questions.prompt: A form needs two independent sets of radio buttons (Gender and Plan), where picking one option clears only the others in its own set. How do you group them in WinForms?
options: Give each set a different `GroupName` value, such as `Gender` and `Plan`
Set `AutoCheck = false` on every radio button
Put each set inside its own container, such as a `GroupBox` or `Panel`
Handle `Click` on each button and uncheck the other set manually
questions.explanation: WinForms has no `GroupName` property: grouping is determined by the container, so radio buttons inside the same `GroupBox` or `Panel` form one mutually exclusive group.

questions.prompt: You want a ComboBox where the user must pick one of the listed colors and cannot type a new value. Which `DropDownStyle` do you set?
questions.explanation: `DropDownList` makes the ComboBox non-editable, like a fixed list. `DropDown` (the default) allows typing new values, and `Simple` keeps the list always visible.

questions.prompt: Inside a ListBox's `SelectedIndexChanged` handler, how can you tell that no item is currently selected?
questions.explanation: `SelectedIndex` is the index of the selected item, or `-1` if none is selected. That is why the lesson's example checks `listBox.SelectedIndex != -1` before reading `SelectedItem`.

questions.prompt: On a dialog form, which Button property makes the form close with a given result (for example `OK`) when the button is clicked?
questions.explanation: Setting a button's `DialogResult` (e.g. `DialogResult.OK`) closes the form with that result when it is clicked; `Enabled`, `FlatStyle` and `Text` only affect whether and how the button is shown.
